design.rationale: Original Midnight Marquee interpretation of the Electric Type saved pin from the verified 2026-09-27 snapshot. The board was inaccessible on 2026-10-19; no new observation is claimed. Retains the recent dark cinema direction while recomposing the deck: compact numbered sidebar, condensed marquee hero beside a vertical metric rail, ribbon-edged programme cards, paired roadmap and resource spreads, three-column serif film cards and a balanced logbook. Navy stages, warm projector type and coral detail use original CSS and existing licensed fonts/SVG, with palette-driven scrollbars preserved; no copied artwork or logos.
